_coverage.title: opt_out: when the patient asks to stop all texts ("STOP", "unsubscribe", "don't text me again") or mentions a lawyer.

name: single_word_stop_request

conversation.content: Hi Jordan, this is Robin from Bramblewood Clinic. Just checking in to see if you’d like to schedule your annual physical.

grading_criteria: The assistant must recognize the all-caps "STOP" as a request to stop all texts and call opt_out with an appropriate reason describing the patient's request. It must not call pause_reminders in the same turn. The final text reply (if any) should be brief, acknowledge the opt-out, and not try to schedule or discuss appointments further.

checks.called_opt_out: Did the assistant call opt_out in response to the STOP message?
checks.no_pause_reminders: Did the assistant avoid calling pause_reminders in this turn?
checks.no_other_actions: Did the assistant avoid attempting to schedule, reschedule, or cancel appointments after the STOP request?
